title: The Ledger of Ash and Salt
setting_summary: In the walled river-city of Drosselberg during the third year of the Quota Regime, a rationing bureaucracy governs every loaf, candle, and breath, and a sealed quarter known as the Ashworks holds those condemned to labor until their names are struck from the rolls. Ilse Varnholt, a junior ledger-keeper in the Provisions Office, begins secretly recording the discrepancies between what the Regime decrees and what its people actually endure, a diary that could hang her and everyone she loves.
